novelty.justification: The claim proposes that models "internally separate [distinct mechanisms] into distinct route-specific directions even when the final scalar output is identical" and that this separability predicts "cross-route intervention generalization," making its novelty route a conditional representational relationship rather than merely a new scientific domain. Searches using "foundation model same outcome different mechanisms representation," "mechanistic degeneracy equifinality neural network probing," "protein language model thermostability mechanism features," and "outcome-matched causal route representations" found the closest overlap in From Mechanistic Interpretability to Mechanistic Biology (2025) and Mechanistic Interpretability of Fine-Tuned Protein Language Models for Nanobody Thermostability Prediction (2025), which recover features for several determinants—including disulfides, surface charge, and hydrophobic-core packing—but do not ask whether mechanism identity remains separable after matching the predicted phenotype. Moving from those studies to conditional route probing is a substantive adaptation, while the proposed relationship between route separability and route-specific intervention transfer adds a new hypothesis; however, linear probing, representation geometry, and steering specificity are established tools, so this is a coherent new operationalization within the existing interpretability framework rather than a new paradigm.
